_README: Scout notes for Presidio Golf Course. Contract in lib/scout.ts (parseScoutCourse) and scripts/validate.mjs — see the Harding file for the full README.

Scorecard: the course's own card (presidiogolf.com/course, read 2026-10-15) for per-hole yardage, par and stroke index; ratings and slopes from GolfPass. GolfPass prints a DIFFERENT men's stroke index (3 as 1, 12 as 2 …); the official card's matches OSM's `handicap` tags hole for hole, so the official card is kept and GolfPass's is not.

Published hole reads are thin: the course's hole-by-hole tour is video only. What the sources say is here; every other green is `unread`, and the card's sand, tee positions and your own two watch rounds (2026-08-22, 2026-09-08) carry the rest.
osm: every hole has a centreline and a green.

plan.title: /plan — the standing rules
plan.note: driver only where there is width; one more club; leave a full wedge, not a half one; bogey is fine, the second dropped stroke is the one to refuse

tee.why: Not the easiest tee shot in San Francisco — a dogleg to open, but a birdie hole once the ball is in play.

target.text: A birdie hole on the card. Fairway first; the number in is a short iron.

tee.why: Elevated tee into a huge gully — that is the landing spot. The second climbs a severe rise; a wood or hybrid into the upslope balloons.

hazards.what: the green is surrounded by bunkers

green.missDead: Anywhere round the green — sand all the way round
green.note: Sloped green completely surrounded by bunkers; lay up and wedge in.

target.text: Three shots. Lay up below the green and wedge it on — nobody is reaching this.

tee.why: Straight uphill to a plateau green: OB stakes down the left, a steep fall-away right. It takes a purely struck drive.

hazards.what: multi-fingered bunker in thick rough, front and right of the green

green.missDead: Short right — the fingered bunker in the thick stuff
green.note: Plateau green; the front-right bunker is the one to carry, so one more club.

target.text: Second-hardest hole. Fairway, one more club up the hill, bogey is fine.
